1. धित, अस्, आ, अम् (earlier form of हित fr. rt.
1. धा), put, placed, arranged, given, caused; re-
solved; [cf. दुर्-ध्˚ and नेम-ध्˚.]
2. धित, अस्, आ, अम्, satisfied, pleased.
1. धीत, अस्, आ, अम्, reflected on, thought about.

धीत 2. धीत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. धे), drunk,
sucked, sucked in, sucked out.
—धीत-रस, अस्, आ,
अम्, having the juice sucked out or extracted.

धितावन्, आ, m., Ved. abounding in gifts (?).
(According to Sāy. Ṛg-veda

, = निहित-हविष्कम्,
[a sacrifice] in which oblations are offered.)
धिति in नेम-ध्˚, मित्र-ध्˚, &c., q. v.

1. धीति, इस्, f. (for 2. धीति see col. 2), Ved.
thought, notion, reflection, idea; devotion, prayer;
(अयस्), f. pl. understanding, wisdom; (Sāy.) the
fingers.

2. धीति, इस्, f. (for 1. धीति see col. 1), drink-
ing; (according to the commentators), thirst.

धित्स्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be wished to be placed,
&c.; desirable to be given or created, &c.
धीतिक, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist patriarch.
